Run one constitutional AI + preference generation step.

detaileddescription.para:
Steps performed:
Apply critique-revision cycles to draft_response.
After all iterations, call the judge on (draft, final_revision).
If judge prefers the revision, create a (query, revision, draft) preference pair; otherwise (query, draft, revision).
Store the pair in the internal dataset when preference_score >= config_.min_preference_score.

query
The user query that generated draft_response.
draft_response
The initial (potentially low-quality) response.
